from typing import Sequence, TypeVar

T = TypeVar('T')


def get_slice(items: Sequence[T], start: int, end: int) -> Sequence[T]:
    """Return a slice of items. (Bug: treats end as inclusive)."""

    return items[start:end + 1]

from typing import Iterable


def pairwise_sum(a: Iterable[int], b: Iterable[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Sum pairwise elements. (Bug: silently drops extra items)."""

    return [x + y for x, y in zip(a, b)]
